setupChecklist.createStorageDesc: Storage is a connection to your data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, etc.). It is required to create and run Data Marts.
setupChecklist.createDraftDataMartDesc: A Data Mart defines what data to collect or transform.
setupChecklist.publishDataMartDesc: Publishing a Data Mart makes it available for Reports and Triggers.
setupChecklist.createFirstDestinationDesc: Destinations are where your reports are delivered — Google Sheets, Data Studio, Email, and more.
setupChecklist.createReportDesc: Open the Data Mart page, go to the Destinations tab and create a report for existing destination.
setupChecklist.runReportDesc: Run your report at least once to generate results.
setupChecklist.inviteTeammatesDesc: Invite your teammates to collaborate in P2PDigital.
setupChecklist.createGoogleSheetsDestinationDesc: Create a destination to deliver reports to Google Sheets.
setupChecklist.installGoogleSheetsExtensionDesc: Install the P2PDigital Data Marts extension from Google Workspace Marketplace to run reports directly in Sheets.
setupChecklist.createRunReportFromExtensionDesc: Open Google Sheets, launch the extension sidebar, create a report, and run it to see your data.
setupChecklist.reportCreatedFromExtension: Report created and run from extension
